boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Fullerton
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in Fullerton and nearby Placentia with late hours documented by current official location pages. Check the linked source before leaving because hours can change.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Table on Nutwood
cards.subtitle: 24-hour diner northeast of California State University-Fullerton
cards.notes: Head to the Nutwood Avenue dining room for an all-hours sit-down meal; confirm ordering options on the official location page first.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Denny's serving diner food around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page identifies the restaurant at 2920 Nutwood Avenue in Fullerton and says it serves breakfast and late-night food 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours from 12:00 a.m. to 11:58 p.m. and describes service as 24/7; dine-in, pickup, and delivery are offered.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Placentia Avenue Stop
cards.subtitle: All-hours counter service north of campus
cards.notes: Use the North Placentia Avenue location when the schedule runs past midnight; check the official page for live ordering status.
cards.short_summary: A Fullerton Del Taco whose official listing shows continuous service.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official location page identifies 1941 North Placentia Avenue in Fullerton and lists the store as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Order from Del Taco in Fullerton, California
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and separately lists 24-hour delivery on displayed days.

cards.title: Burgers Just East of the 57
cards.subtitle: Late dining on Chapman Avenue near California State University-Fullerton
cards.notes: Cross into Placentia for dine-in service after an evening on campus; note that this specific restaurant has no drive-through.
cards.short_summary: A late-open, dine-in In-N-Out explicitly described as near CSU Fullerton.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page places this restaurant at 825 West Chapman Avenue, describes it as near CSU Fullerton, and lists closing at 1:00 a.m. or later.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Placentia, CA, 825 W. Chapman Ave.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in seating is available, but there is no drive-through.

cards.title: Pancakes at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour dining room near Harbor Boulevard
cards.notes: Choose the Orangethorpe Avenue dining room for an overnight sit-down option, then verify service modes before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: An all-day breakfast restaurant with a dining room open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official Fullerton page lists the restaurant at 151 West Orangethorpe Avenue as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in and takeout.
cards.source_title: Fullerton Breakfast & Pancake Specials — IHOP Location in 92832
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday through Sunday as open 24 hours and identifies dine-in, curbside pickup, online ordering, takeout, and delivery.

cards.title: The South Harbor All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: Around-the-clock diner service south of downtown Fullerton
cards.notes: Take Harbor Boulevard south for a late sit-down meal or pickup order; review the official listing before departing for current service.
cards.short_summary: A second all-hours Fullerton diner on the Harbor Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page identifies its 1375 South Harbor Boulevard restaurant and says it offers breakfast and late-night food 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official listing shows daily hours from 12:00 a.m. to 11:58 p.m. and describes the restaurant as operating 24/7 with dine-in, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: A Late Drive-Through on Harbor
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-through service until at least 1:00 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the Harbor Boulevard restaurant for a late burger run with seating or drive-through service; weekend closing is thirty minutes later.
cards.short_summary: A Fullerton In-N-Out with both seating and a drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page identifies the restaurant at 1180 South Harbor Boulevard and lists closing at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Fullerton, CA, 1180 S. Harbor Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; drive-through and dine-in seating are available.

cards.title: The Weekend Rosecrans Run
cards.subtitle: Late counter service in western Fullerton
cards.notes: Save this Rosecrans Avenue stop for Friday or Saturday, when its official schedule extends two hours beyond the weekday close.
cards.short_summary: A western Fullerton Del Taco with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official page identifies 1020 Rosecrans Avenue and lists service until midnight most nights and 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Order from Del Taco in Fullerton, California
cards.access_notes: Store hours extend to 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the page also lists pickup, drive-through, dine-in, takeout, and delivery.

cards.title: A Family-Friendly Downtown Late Meal
cards.subtitle: All-ages dining on North Harbor Boulevard
cards.notes: Plan this downtown stop for Tuesday or Thursday through Saturday, and request a regular dining table rather than treating it as nightlife.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Mexican restaurant that expressly welcomes all ages.
cards.evidence_claim: Madero 1899's official site calls the restaurant family-friendly and welcoming to all ages, and lists midnight or later closing on Tuesday and Thursday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Madero 1899 | Authentic Mexican Restaurant in Fullerton
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Tuesday until 12:00 a.m.; Thursday–Friday until 1:30 a.m.; and Saturday–Sunday until 1:30 a.m. It expressly welcomes all ages.

cards.title: Korean Comfort Food After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Late dining on South Harbor Boulevard
cards.notes: Go Thursday through Saturday for service after midnight, and arrive at least thirty minutes before closing because the kitchen posts a last call.
cards.short_summary: A South Harbor Korean-fusion restaurant with its own published late schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: J's Korean Cuisine's official site identifies its restaurant at 600 South Harbor Boulevard and publishes closing times as late as 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: J's Korean Cuisine — AYCE Chicken Wings
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Tuesday–Wednesday until midnight, Thursday until 1:00 a.m., and Friday–Saturday until 2:00 a.m.; last call is 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Pizza and Arcade Games Until 2:00
cards.subtitle: Family restaurant on East Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Choose Thursday through Saturday for the late schedule, and keep the outing centered on pizza and the family arcade area.
cards.short_summary: A downtown family pizza restaurant with arcade games and late weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bowery's official site describes the venue as a family restaurant with pizza and arcade games and lists 2:00 a.m. closing Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Thursday–Friday from 4:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. and Saturday from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.; it identifies the business as a family restaurant.
